title: Iridescent Bubble Cluster
description: A dense cluster of multicolored, iridescent bubbles and circular forms floats against a deep black background. The translucent spheres display rainbow-like color refractions in teal, orange, pink, yellow, and blue, creating an organic, almost cellular pattern with a large dark void in the lower center.
prompt: Highly detailed abstract composition of countless overlapping translucent bubbles and spherical cells floating in a dark void, displaying vibrant iridescent rainbow refractions with strong teal, magenta, orange and yellow color shifts, organic cellular texture, deep black negative space creating natural voids, glossy reflective surfaces, macro view, moody atmospheric lighting.
